# Acme India Pvt Ltd — Travel & Expense Policy

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | 1.0 |
| Effective date | 2026-10-01 |
| Currency | INR |
| Policy owner | Finance Controller |

> This is a fictional policy for a fictional company, created for a portfolio project. It is not tax or legal advice.

## Definitions

- **Grade:** G1 = Individual contributor; G2 = Manager; G3 = Senior leader.
- **City tier:** X cities are Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune. Y cities are listed in Annex A. All other cities are tier Z.
- **Trip:** continuous travel away from the employee's base location, from departure to return.

## 1. General

### GEN-01 — Scope and business purpose
This policy applies to all employees travelling or incurring expenses on company business. Every claim must state its business purpose. Expenses are reimbursed in INR at actual cost, up to the limits in this policy.

### GEN-02 — Submission window
Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense date. Claims submitted later are not reimbursable.

### GEN-03 — Receipts and self-declaration
Every expense needs an original receipt or invoice. If a receipt is lost, the employee may submit a self-declaration for items up to ₹500 each, and no more than 2 self-declarations per calendar month.

### GEN-04 — Duplicate claims
An expense may be claimed only once. A claim with the same vendor, date and amount as a previously submitted claim is a duplicate and is not reimbursable.

### GEN-05 — Cash payments
No single payment made in cash may exceed ₹10,000. Cash payments above this amount are not reimbursable. Use a corporate card or digital payment instead.

### GEN-06 — Personal expenses
The following are never reimbursable: minibar, spa, salon, personal toiletries, movies, fines and penalties, loyalty or membership fees, gifts for self.

## 2. Hotel accommodation

### HTL-01 — Hotel nightly limits
The maximum room rate per night, excluding taxes, is:

| Grade | X city | Y city | Z city |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | ₹4,500 | ₹3,500 | ₹2,500 |
| G2 | ₹6,500 | ₹5,000 | ₹3,500 |
| G3 | ₹9,000 | ₹7,000 | ₹5,000 |


### HTL-02 — Hotel tax invoice
Hotel bills must be a GST tax invoice issued in the name of Acme India Pvt Ltd and showing the company GSTIN. Claims without a compliant invoice will be returned to the employee for correction.

### HTL-03 — Weekend stays
Hotel stays over a weekend are reimbursable when staying is more economical for the company than returning to base, or when business needs require the employee to remain at the location.

### HTL-04 — Laundry
Laundry is reimbursable only on trips of 4 nights or more.

## 3. Meals

### MEAL-01 — Daily meal limits
Meals while travelling are reimbursed at actual cost up to a daily limit:

| Grade | Per day |
|---|---|
| G1 | ₹1,000 |
| G2 | ₹1,500 |
| G3 | ₹2,500 |


### MEAL-02 — Itemised meal receipts
Meal receipts must be itemised. A receipt showing only a total amount will be returned to the employee.

### MEAL-03 — Alcohol on routine meals
Alcohol is not reimbursable as part of routine meals. See ENT-03 for client entertainment.

## 4. Entertainment

### ENT-01 — Client entertainment
Meals and hospitality for clients or prospective clients are reimbursable up to ₹3,000 per attendee, where the purpose is to develop or maintain a business relationship. The claim must list all attendees, their organisations, and the business purpose.

### ENT-02 — Team meals
Team meals are reimbursable up to ₹1,000 per head only for team celebrations approved in advance by the team's manager.

### ENT-03 — Alcohol during client entertainment
Alcohol may be reimbursed as part of client entertainment when consumption is reasonable and appropriate to the occasion.

## 5. Local transport

### TRN-01 — Local transport daily limits
Local transport (cabs, auto-rickshaws, metro) is reimbursed at actual cost up to a daily limit:

| Grade | Per day |
|---|---|
| G1 | ₹1,500 |
| G2 | ₹2,500 |
| G3 | Actual cost |


### TRN-02 — Premium cab categories
Premium cab categories (e.g., sedan or SUV tiers) may be used when travelling after 22:00, when accompanying clients, or when otherwise necessary for business.

## 6. Air travel

### AIR-01 — Class of air travel
All grades travel in economy class. G3 employees may travel in business class on flights with a scheduled duration of more than 4 hours.

### AIR-02 — Advance booking
Flights should be booked at least 7 days in advance wherever practicable. Later bookings must include a reason.

## 7. GST and invoices

### GST-01 — GSTIN on invoices
Hotel and air travel invoices should carry the company GSTIN so that the company can evaluate input tax credit (ITC) eligibility.

### GST-02 — Blocked input tax credit
Input tax credit is not claimed on food and beverages, outdoor catering, or travel benefits extended to employees on vacation, which are blocked credits under Section 17(5) of the CGST Act, 2017.

### GST-03 — Hotel rooms at or below the review threshold
Hotel invoices where the room rate is ₹7,500 or less per night are tagged for tax team review before any input tax credit is claimed.

## 8. Other expenses

### MISC-01 — Connectivity
Mobile data or internet purchased during a trip is reimbursable up to ₹500 per trip.

### MISC-02 — Incidental expenses
Other incidental expenses reasonably necessary for business travel may be reimbursed with a short justification.

## 9. Exceptions

### EXC-01 — Policy exceptions
Any expense outside this policy requires written approval, before the expense is incurred, from a G3 leader and the Finance Controller. Approved exceptions must be attached to the claim.
